title: Vercel Agent Skills
tagline: Installable skills including web design guidelines — taste you can hand an agent.
note: The closest thing to pointing an agent at good taste. The web-design-guidelines skill grounds output in real product patterns instead of generic AI slop — install it before any agent-built UI.

title: Anthropic Skills
tagline: Anthropic's skill patterns plus reusable document skills for agents.
note: Read this to learn the skill format itself — how to package reusable know-how an agent can load on demand. The document skills show what 'done well' looks like as machine-readable process.

title: Figma Dev Mode MCP Server
tagline: The official bridge: selection, variables, and code context for design-to-code.
note: Structured design context instead of screenshots — selection, components, and variables your agent can actually reason about. The foundation of any serious Figma-to-code workflow.

title: Framelink Figma MCP Server
tagline: The open-source alternative for piping Figma context to coding agents.
note: When the official server isn't an option, this community bridge covers the same ground: layouts, styles, and assets as structured data. OSS means you can read exactly what context your agent receives.

title: shadcn MCP Server
tagline: Let the agent pull real components from registries instead of hallucinating APIs.
note: The pattern to copy everywhere: give agents the actual registry — blocks, demos, source — and generated UI stops inventing props. Registry-first is the antidote to confident fabrication.

title: Playwright MCP Server
tagline: A real browser for your agent — screenshots as ground truth for what it built.
note: Close the loop: build, screenshot, compare, fix. An agent that can see its own output in a real browser is an order of magnitude more reliable on UI work.

title: Chrome DevTools MCP Server
tagline: Performance, accessibility, and network inspection for agents.
note: Turns audits into agent workflows: trace a slow interaction, check contrast, inspect the network — all from the same session that's writing the code.

title: Tokens Studio
tagline: Figma tokens synced to code in a portable format — the workflow, not just the plugin.
note: The reusable knowledge is the pipeline: design tokens authored in Figma, stored as code, transformed to every platform. Learn the workflow once, reuse it on every system.

title: Tailwind CSS v4 Upgrade Guide
tagline: The codemod-first migration path — hand it to the agent before touching v3 code.
note: Skills aren't only MCP servers: upgrade guides are agent fuel too. The v3-to-v4 codemod plus the CSS-first config explainer is the template for migrating any codebase with AI help.

title: Design Tokens Community Group
tagline: The portable token format and the community behind it — read before inventing a schema.
note: If your tokens can't be expressed in the community format, that's a smell. Read the spec before designing a naming scheme — it settles most layering arguments in advance.
